blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.taxRegion` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a tax region. It sends a request to the
[Create Tax Region](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#tax-regions\_posttaxregions)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the tax region to create.

children.name: country_code
children.description: The country code of the tax region.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the tax provider.

children.name: province_code
children.description: The lower-case [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO\_3166-2) province or state code of the tax region.

children.name: parent_id
children.description: The ID of the parent tax region.

children.name: default_tax_rate
children.description: The default tax rate of the tax region.

children.name: rate
children.description: The percentage rate of the default tax rate.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the default tax rate.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the default tax rate.

children.name: is_combinable
children.description: Whether the default tax rate is combinable with other tax rates.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the default tax rate.
